overview: UKG Pro (formerly Ultimate Software UltiPro) uses OAuth 2.0. You register an application through the UKG developer programme, receive a Client ID and Client Secret, and redirect users through UKG Pro's authorisation flow.

oauth_client_id.label: Client ID
oauth_client_id.description: Issued after registering your integration at connect.ultipro.com or through UKG's partner programme.

oauth_client_secret.label: Client Secret
oauth_client_secret.description: Issued alongside the Client ID. Keep it confidential.

steps.title: Register for API access
steps.description: Go to connect.ultipro.com and apply for API access. UKG Pro API requires partner registration or customer API enablement.

steps.title: Receive credentials
steps.description: After approval, UKG provides a Client ID and Client Secret. Note your Customer API Key — it identifies your tenant in API calls.
steps.tip: The Customer API Key is separate from the OAuth credentials and required for tenant identification.

steps.title: Configure redirect URL
steps.description: Provide the Nolixan callback URL as the authorised redirect URI.
steps.warning: Redirect URI must match exactly during the OAuth flow.

steps.title: Connect
steps.description: In Nolixan, create the integration with the Client ID, Client Secret, and Customer API Key (as connection config). Then initiate the OAuth flow.

tips: UKG Pro API access requires a formal approval process — allow lead time before integration.
Access tokens expire and Nolixan handles auto-refresh.
The Customer API Key is passed as the 'US-Customer-Api-Key' header in all API requests.
warnings: UKG Pro API is enterprise-grade — ensure your use case qualifies for the access tier you apply for.
Never expose the Client Secret or Customer API Key in client-side code.
